topic: Classifying Materials by Absorbency, Floating, and Sinking
key_concepts: Materials can be classified based on their properties.
Absorb means to take in a liquid naturally or gradually.
Porous materials have small holes that allow air or liquid to pass through.
Non-porous materials do not allow air or liquid to pass through.
Cotton is very porous and is a natural absorbent of water.
Plastic is non-porous and does not allow water to pass through.
Some materials absorb water more than others.
Sink means to fall to the bottom of water.
Float means to stay on top of water.
Some objects float at first but then sink as they absorb water through holes.
